correctness.rationale: Fano incidence axioms imply exactly 42 distinct eight-vertex equidistance sets and none for opposite part pairs; failure to resolve is equivalent to containment in one such set. A combinatorial argument reduces all five-element metric bases to 21 pairs of lines times four noncollinear transversals plus 84 duals. Exact self-contained standard-library Python enumerates all 16,384 masks, independently checks direct distance vectors versus forbidden-containment, confirms each coefficient and all 336 automorphisms, and proves that 168 bases form one orbit. Every finite mask is examined, not sampled.
